fact: A meeting chaired by the minister of state on 2026-09-20 was attended by the head of the General Authority for Cybersecurity and Digital Sovereignty, and by the head of the National Authority for Information Security and Safety, both stated as existing national bodies; the meeting discussed drawing up an integrated national cybersecurity plan.
system: General Authority for Cybersecurity and Digital Sovereignty

fact: Cabinet Decision 358 of 2026, signed by Prime Minister Dbeibah, creates the National Authority for Cybersecurity and Digital Sovereignty as a public body under the Council of Ministers, with duties including threat monitoring, early warning and incident response.
system: National Authority for Cybersecurity and Digital Sovereignty

fact: LANA reports the National Authority for Information Security and Safety was founded in 2013 by government decision to protect Libya's digital infrastructure.
system: National Authority for Information Security and Safety (NISSA)

fact: A NISSA official says the authority launched the national cybersecurity strategy in February 2023.
